## Adding an entry

Create `NN-slug.md` with a `# Title` and, directly under it, one
blockquote line (fields joined by ` · `):

```
> **Status:** OPEN · **Area:** frontend
```

`Status` ∈ OPEN · PARTIAL · DONE · REFERENCE · DECLINED. `Area` is one or
more of frontend, rust, ports, conformance, spec, infra, docs. `**Ref:**`
(free text) is optional — shown for PARTIAL/DONE/REFERENCE/DECLINED, not
for OPEN. `mise run docs` fails if the header is missing or malformed;
rerun `mise run docs:backlog-index` to refresh this file.
